resources.string: Enable USB or wireless debugging, connect your computer via ADB, then execute the command from this app while its short startup wait is open. The installed path may change after an app update. Official Shizuku is not required.

1. Install Android platform tools on your computer, connect this device via USB or wireless ADB, and authorize it.\n2. Check adb devices, then run the complete command below in your computer terminal. If multiple devices are connected, add -s DEVICE_SERIAL after adb.\n3. Keep the app running and wait for the service to become ready.

This startup wait closes in about 110 seconds. After cancellation, timeout, or app process exit, open a new wait before running the command again. The installed path can be reused until the app is updated.
